name: The Yeatman
positioning: Wine-themed luxury hotel on a hillside among the Port wine lodges, on the south bank of the Douro, looking over Porto's historic centre
best_for: Wine lovers who want tastings, wine dinners and vineyard visits
Travelers who want a terrace or balcony with views over Porto

facts.text: The Yeatman occupies a hillside position on the south bank of the River Douro.
The hotel is set amidst the Port wine lodges, on a hill overlooking Porto, within 7 acres of land.
Every room at The Yeatman has views over the historic centre of Porto.
All rooms and suites have a terrace or balcony with views over Porto.
The Panoramic Deluxe Suites have a wider, panoramic view of the Douro River and the historic city of Porto.
The Yeatman is a member of the Relais & Chateaux collection of hotels.
Inspired by Porto's British wine-shipper heritage, the hotel blends Portuguese hospitality traditions with a British flair for understated, stylish comfort.
The cellars of The Yeatman house one of the most comprehensive collections of Portuguese wines.
Partner wine producers take part in the hotel's programme of tastings, seminars and wine dinners.
The hotel's wine experts are on hand to guide guests in discovering Portugal's wine regions.
Visits can be arranged to vineyards and estates in the Douro Valley, Minho, Dao and Bairrada wine regions.
The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant holds two Michelin Stars, awarded in November 2016.

highlights.text: Partner wineries sponsor individual rooms and suites, with pictures and objects about each winery adding an individual accent to each guest room.
The hotel has outdoor and indoor infinity swimming pools.
The wine theme extends to The Yeatman Wine Spa, with its exclusive skincare products and therapies.
The Presidential Suite Panoramic has a private pool, a barrel bed, a spacious terrace and a private garden, with views over Porto and the Douro.

considerations.text: The hotel's address is in Vila Nova de Gaia, on the south bank of the Douro, looking over Porto's historic centre rather than in it.
The hotel does not recommend The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant for children under 12; its menu is a tasting menu with no children's menu, while The Orangerie has a children's menu.
WhataHotel notes the hillside location means getting transportation to the city centre.

sources.title: The Yeatman - Luxury Wine Hotel & Spa in Porto
